inventoryNotes: Groups and detailed categories organise the restoration work; they are not a verbatim reproduction of the game's internal asset taxonomy.
Available status records a published catalogue release. It does not mean every livery, lower-detail model, emissive map or gameplay test is finished.
Each base hull or explicitly described batch counts once. Liveries, screenshots, deployment states and source-name aliases do not create extra completion units.
Named-vessel entries marked pending-audit remain visible but do not count toward progress. A shared ship class does not prove shared meshes or textures, and distinct extracted hulls remain separate.
Names and aliases preserve existing published IDs and common source spellings. Unverified name-to-mesh mappings, including new transport entries, still need an extracted-source audit.
Component packs are planned batches, not claims about the number of unique meshes or shared texture sets. Existing missiles, torpedoes, launch pods and the fighter fuel pod remain one ordnance pack.
The named station entries reserve restoration scopes; shared geometry and mission-specific variants will be audited before their final material inventory is assigned.
No speculative planet or backdrop roster has been added. Environment and Planets remains available as a category for future verified scope.
